prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-19
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 802bcfea206d72c7
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Fetch makes no progress with max_addr=0x00000000 because mem_la_read never asserts so no mem_xfer/mem_done fetch completes. Expected mem_la_read to assert for a normal idle fetch, but picorv32.v:380 uses && between the normal-read term and the COMPRESSED_ISA second-word term instead of ||, requiring !mem_state and mem_xfer simultaneously. That conjunction is unsatisfiable in normal fetch, stalling the core and tripping TRAP: no progress.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 802bcfea206d72c7 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
